subject: Ventana hyperAPI p95/p99 probe — post-demo ops & runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Liu <alex.liu@ventana.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Ventana hyperAPI comparison — p95/p99 probe & proposed runbook

Alex — thanks again for a productive demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the bench runs: 

What we heard from Ventana:
- Primary concern is tail latency (p95/p99) for short chat-turns and medium-length summarization (~150–600 tokens).
- You want a head-to-head versus the hyperscaler endpoint you're testing in parallel (HyperCloud) and a run that mirrors a subset of your prod traffic.

Our proposal (high-level):
1) 24-hour A/B probe (Redwood vs HyperCloud) using a 10k prompt set that mixes: 60% short chat, 30% multi-turn context, 10% summarization.
2) Metrics captured: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, failure/retry rates, KV-cache hit rate, cost-per-1k-tokens.
3) Two routing modes during the run: low-latency (no batching, disabled KV prefetch) and throughput-optimized (aggressive batching + KV cache warm).
4) Canary rollout of a quantized variant (int8) on the throughput run to surface quality regressions.

Deliverables from Redwood by EOD Thursday:
- bench probe spec (attached: ventana-bench-probe-spec.md) — includes prompt distribution and pod configs.
- sample traffic file for validation (we'll ask you to confirm it mirrors your prod sample).
- runbook and minimal commands to replay the probe (bench-runbook-v2.md).

Asks from Ventana:
- Confirm the 10k prompt set is representative (we can accept a smaller sample if you prefer).
- Provide read-only creds for the HyperCloud test endpoint and any rate limits we should configure.
- Permission to apply a temporary burst (12 hours) on a dedicated cluster during the run (billing credit discussed separately).

Attachments: ventana-bench-probe-spec.md, ventana-matrix.xlsx, bench-runbook-v2.md

Next: if you're good with this scope, we'll finalize the run commands and start the probe on Friday morning (US Pacific).

Thanks — Jonas

--

From: Alex Liu <alex.liu@ventana.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Ventana hyperAPI comparison — p95/p99 probe & proposed runbook

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan and the spec. A few quick points from our side: 

1) The 10k prompt set looks good but can we seed it with 2k actual prod samples? I attached a small traffic dump (ventana-traffic-sample.json) — it's scrubbed.
2) We'll send a HyperCloud test endpoint and an API key (read-only) by EOD. Expect that endpoint to throttle at ~40 rps; if Redwood needs to ramp we'll coordinate with eng.
3) Procurement wants to see a brief SOW / confirmation of time window and any credits you mentioned. Can Marissa loop in commercial on that?

We are comfortable with the two routing modes. Can you also include per-route token accounting in the output CSV? That helps our cost comparison.

I'll confirm the test window after procurement signs off. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex

--
Alex Liu | Director, Product Ops
Ventana AI

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alex Liu <alex.liu@ventana.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: runbook & ops split for Ventana probe (please approve burst)

Marissa / Neha — moving this thread internal for ops items, copying Alex for visibility.

Summary of asks that need action on our side:
- Finalize bench-runbook-v2.md (I attached a draft) — tasks: data ingestion, warm cache run, low-latency pass, throughput pass, quantized canary. Estimated runtime: 20–36 hours including warming.
- Marissa: can you approve a 12-hour burst on a dedicated cluster (up to 4x current commit) for the throughput pass? We'll apply for a short credit until procurement confirms SOW. Without the burst we'll have to throttle the probe which could affect p95/p99 comparability.
- Neha: please prepare per-route token accounting output (CSV export + token cost calc) and add KV-cache hit-rate logging to the metrics pipeline. Use the sample schema in ventana-matrix.xlsx.
- Ops notes: route A (no-batch) should set max_batch_size=1, kv_prefetch=false. Route B (throughput) max_batch_size=64, kv_prefetch=true, quant_variant=int8 enabled for canary.

I'll coordinate the run start (targeting Friday 11/17 09:00 PT) once Marissa confirms the burst. Alex — we'll incorporate your 2k prod-seed and the per-route CSV.

Attachments: bench-runbook-v2.md (draft), ventana-matrix.xlsx

Jonas
